note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. There were no contests (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1955, p. 8: 'There will be no contests for Castlederg Rural Council'). All sixteen divisions are recorded from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Ulster Herald, 21 May 1955, p. 2). The notice crosses the Clare and Clunahill rows; their members are filed by the other-names and abode columns and the 1952 and 1958 returns (see those divisions' notes). Returned unopposed.
